description: Local: Tricot custom step order from the Cabinet Builder (SO-02). Read-only, guarded.

args.function: () => { const txt=s=>(s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); const labels=['Tricot Models','Tricot Cabinet Builder','Cabinet Finishes','Countertop & Basin','Accessories','Faucet Details','Summary']; const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('a,button,span,div,li,p')].filter(e=>e.children.length===0&&labels.includes(txt(e.innerText))).map(e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return {t:txt(e.innerText),x:Math.round(r.left),y:Math.round(r.top),shown:r.width>0}}).filter(e=>e.shown&&e.y<200).sort((a,b)=>a.x-b.x).map(e=>e.t); const nav=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,a')].map(e=>txt(e.innerText)).filter(t=>/^(Next|Back)\b/.test(t)); return {path:location.pathname, tabs:[...new Set(tabs)], nav}; }
